architecture_freeze.source_commit_scope: Supersedes retained_comparison_architecture_20260811. Living reference cells are Decision 0050 current-stack fills, Decision 0046 E5/G5 rules peers, and Sol raw_lane LLM-only. Retired v08, 2-call, June 7 three-way, July 18 v0.7 rows, and the 13 Aug explorer tree.
architecture_freeze.mutation_policy: A semantic prompt, scorer, split, repair, runtime route, component-graph, or deterministic extraction-ruleset change requires a new freeze ID and complete replay. Always-on validation hashes sealed result artifacts and split manifests only. Living source, configs, prompts, docs, and CI files are presence-checked; their identity is git plus no-call replay. The Gan rules-only extraction ruleset is pinned by the hash of the reference cell's replay artifact, not by a policy_files entry; policy_files roles are a closed set and no role fits an extraction rule module. Re-run scripts/verify_reference_evidence.py to detect a rules-lane change.

model_policy.new_runtime_rule: Name every exact provider/API identifier and runtime condition in a predeclaration before calls; a completed local run is not retained holdout evidence until its aggregate-only summary is committed and hash-selected.
model_policy.route_policy: Hosted and local routes retain their recorded transport, thinking, context, endpoint, and hardware conditions; provider differences remain comparison caveats.

execution_policy.model_calls: Predeclaration required; this architecture freeze does not authorize new model calls.
